AssetPlus Launches New Portfolio Management Services

AssetPlus has launched new portfolio management services aimed at assisting Mutual Fund Distributors (MFDs) in growing their businesses and retaining high-net-worth clients. The service is designed to support MFD partners by providing tools and strategies for client acquisition and retention within the high-net-worth segment.
